task.goal: Delete all but one of any expenses in pro expense that are exact duplicates, ensuring at least one instance of each unique expense remains.
task.final_summary: I deleted one of the two identical Dress expenses (406.99, yesterday 7:00 PM, note "Want to have"), leaving one copy. The Expense Logs list now shows six distinct expenses with no duplicates: Educational Software, Dress, Interest Income, Fine Dining, Therapy Sessions, and Dining Out. The date filter is limited to Oct 7-14, which the date picker shows is the full range of data in the app, and the list cannot scroll further.

steps.note: Observe current screen and identify app
Launch Pro Expense and observe home screen
Open navigation drawer to find full expense list
Map full expense list (levels 1) to count all rows
Open Filter to see date range options and whether more expenses exist
Change filter start date to an early date to reveal all expenses
Cancel date picker, then open first Dress row to compare details
Dismiss filter sheet, then open first Dress row
Open first Dress expense and read its full details
Open second Dress row and read its details to compare
Read second Dress row detail sheet
Confirm deletion of the duplicate Dress expense
Verify list now has one Dress row
Recount list with map_app levels 1 to confirm no duplicates remain
Task complete; final list verified with 6 unique expenses
